glosses: rhythm (variation of strong and weak emphasis over time, e.g. in music or speech)
pattern, rhythm (series of repetitive events or actions spaced out evenly)

examples.text: Spüre den Rhythmus und folge dem Takt!
examples.en: Feel the rhythm and follow the beat.

examples.text: Mir gefällt der langsame Rhythmus dieses Liedes.
examples.en: I like the slow rhythm of that song.
